entries.name: Quickening
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim per naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies (g.tempo stem `tempo`, existingFamilies). `frames: ["plant"]` and `side: "plant"` follow ssot-affixes.md §4.4's frame filter ("quickening... never roll on a humanoid item") and atom-family-library.md §3.1's own Side column for this row, which reads `plant` directly rather than `both` — distinct from `frames` (body archetype) the same way the exemplar's `side` and `frames` are two separate axes. NOT bindable today: bands.v1.json's channelFamilyGroups.primaryChannel lists quickening among the 14 stat.modify families but AtomKindRegistry.cs's `PrimaryChannels` (the 8 real primary channels) excludes `attackInterval` — the code comment there names it a "cheat-document key that bypasses the modifier bag entirely and cannot be reached by an effect until E16 promotes them", and `Validate()` rejects any `channel` not in that list with `BadParamValue`. atom-family-library.md §5 records the same gap as an owner decision to promote all three channels once the channel-extension spec ships. This row imports and binds nowhere today, the same declared-but-quarantined honesty the elemental_power exemplar applies to `stat.derived`. `nameWords`: Band C `Blooming` is ssot-affixes.md §4.12's shipped plant-frame override (the humanoid word `Quickening` is moot since the family never rolls on humanoid at all); bands A/B are minted in the same botanical-escalation register.

entries.name: Flourishing
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim. Faster sun income (`produceInterval`), atom-family-library.md §3.1's "faster sun" note; category E (economy) has no direct combat-posture tag, so `utility` is used per tags.v1.json's own definition ("resource generation... or support") — the same E-to-utility mapping ssot-affixes.md's group table implies for `g.economy`. Same NOT-bindable-today gap as `quickening`: `produceInterval` is absent from `AtomKindRegistry.PrimaryChannels`, rejected with `BadParamValue` until E16. No shipped word table exists for this family in ssot-affixes.md §4.12's illustrative sample (only quickening/mending/regeneration/sunbloom/evasion/swiftness are shown), so all three `nameWords` bands are minted here, reusing the family's own name at Band C the same way `quickening`'s humanoid word reused its family name.

entries.name: Swiftness
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim. `frames: ["humanoid"]` / `side: "zombie"` mirror ssot-affixes.md §4.4 ("swiftness never rolls on a plant item") and atom-family-library.md §3.1's Side column, which reads `zombie` for this row — described there as "the pressure lever". Same NOT-bindable-today gap: `zombieSpeed` is outside `AtomKindRegistry.PrimaryChannels`, pending E16's channel-extension promotion (atom-family-library.md §5). `nameWords`: ssot-affixes.md §4.12's plant-override table gives `Swift` for this family with no band number attached (unlike quickening/mending/evasion, which are explicitly labelled `(band C)`) — placed at Band C here for consistency with those siblings, with A/B minted below it in the same register.

entries.name: Hastened Reflexes
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `tempo` (naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies), word `haste`. `quickening`'s Increased-op sibling, the same relationship `ferocity` has to `might` (bands.v1.json's own worked example gives `might` Flat sharePermille 45 against `ferocity` Increased sharePermille 16 — the Increased sibling is deliberately the smaller pull, hence `powerBand: low` against `quickening`'s `medium`). Closes the gap the exemplar's own sizing table flags: g.tempo is the only prefix group in atom-family-library.md §3.1 with exactly one op per channel instead of the Flat/Increased(/More) triad g.life and g.attack both carry. Same runtime-pending gap as its Flat sibling — no authored `sharePermille` exists for this channel either, which is expected of any brand-new family (bands.v1.json §`sharePermilleOwnership` — a generator with no authored share rejects at import, the same as every other NEW family across this corpus, not a defect specific to this row).

entries.name: Bountiful Yield
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `tempo`, word `yield`. `flourishing`'s Increased-op sibling, same Flat/Increased split as `tempo-haste`/`quickening` above, applied to the economy channel instead of the offense one. `powerBand: low` for the same reason: an Increased-op sibling is the finer-grained, smaller-share rider next to its Flat sibling's `medium`.

entries.name: Surging Advance
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `tempo`, word `surge`. `swiftness`'s Increased-op sibling, completing the Flat/Increased pair on the zombie side the way `tempo-haste`/`tempo-yield` complete it on the plant side. `powerBand: low` for the same Flat-vs-Increased sizing judgement as its two siblings above.

entries.name: Stampede
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `tempo`, word `stampede`. The `More`-op rare sibling g.tempo was missing entirely — `bulwark` (`maxHp` More) and `savagery` (`atk` More) are each atom-family-library.md §3.1's "rare tier band only" family for their group, and g.tempo had no equivalent for its pressure channel. `powerBand: high` reflects the same rare-appearance, larger-single-pull judgement as those two siblings. `nameWords` carries a single Band-C-only word, following the exact pattern `bulwark` itself already shows in ssot-affixes.md §4.12's sample table (`— | — | Adamant`, i.e. bands A/B deliberately unpopulated for a family that only ever shows up at the top of the ladder).
